newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber unchanged, trade inactive.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber unchanged, trade inactive.

text.p: Indonesian rubber prices were unchanged in the late session on Monday, with buyers mostly sidelined waiting for lower values, dealers said.

They said tyre-grade October/November SIR20 was quoted at 55.25-55.75 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and at 55.00-55.50 cents fob Palembang, Surabaya and Padang, and at 54.75-55.25 cents fob Jambi and Pontianak.
"Buyers are looking at 54.00-54.50 cents in Medan, which is too low for me," one Medan dealer said. "They feel that there are no factors for offer prices to be at current levels."
"The market is in the doldrums," another dealer said. "There has hardly been any activity. Demand has been very poor."
Dealers said the key growing region of Medan had been experiencing regular showers, making tapping difficult.
They said RSS1, SIR3CV, SIR10 and SIR5 also remained soft due to continued weak demand.
High amoniac grade latex with 60 percent dry rubber content was last traded at 2,230 rupiah/kg against the previous 2,250 rupiah in the local markets of Bandung and Tangerang, they said.
